## Objective

Turn permitted sources into durable reviewed semantic candidates.

## Scope

- Proposal history
- Actual native generation
- Validation, publication and refinement

## Entry conditions

- Real core/shape/reasoning checks and existing publication interfaces are available.

## Exit criteria

- A generated candidate can be attributed, validated, revised, rejected and published under exact current authority.

## Risks

- A captured candidate or validation pass cannot approve itself.

Add proposal identities, append-only candidate/review versions, semantic diffs and exact source/context/generator attribution.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Drafts must stay out of approved retrieval and projection cleanup.

### Acceptance criteria

- Proposal revisions preserve earlier bytes/history, source hashes, uncertainty and supersession.
- Saving or revising a proposal changes no approved ontology and invalidates obsolete approvals.

### Planned verification

- Save/reopen/revise/reject candidates and verify durable identity and prior revisions.
- Exercise stale review and concurrent draft-save conflicts with protected canonical hashes.

## TASK-016 - Implement the permitted native generation workflow

Extend the ontology skill and CLI handoff protocol to prepare immutable selected requests, invoke an authorized native generator and capture its actual structured result.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-015, REQ-016, REQ-019, REQ-041 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/SKILL.md, SKILLS-depo/ontology/references/proposal-generation.md, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_generation.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_generation_contract.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-015, TASK-014 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Host availability is explicit; generation cannot be simulated as a successful runtime when no permitted runtime exists.

### Acceptance criteria

- An actual source-to-candidate model run records the request digest, available native/model settings and supporting references.
- Embedded instructions remain data; the generator has no publishing authority and selects no new service, credential or model installation.
- CLI/skill and workbench share one durable request/proposal API.

### Planned verification

- Exercise the protocol with a real permitted native run on a selected safe source packet.
- Test instruction injection, fabricated source references, malformed responses and missing runtime without accepting prewritten candidates as generation evidence.

## TASK-019 - Implement bounded finding-directed refinement

Feed named validation or reviewer findings into revised generation requests and compare competency behavior across attributable candidate versions.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-019, REQ-021, REQ-041 |

| Dependencies | TASK-018 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- No autonomous canonical rewrite or self-training loop.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each revision addresses observed findings and retains exact lineage; repeated failures or the configured attempt bound stop.
- Improvement, regression and neutral results are reported without assuming study percentages or modifying the runtime itself.

### Planned verification

- Run an actual revision responding to one concrete validation defect.
- Exercise unchanged-failure and exhausted-attempt stopping paths.
